name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the platform in the log, and of the Doorbell accessory when it is first created.

host.title: Intercom IP address
host.description: Local IP address of the Comelit monitor or Extender, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Give it a fixed address in your router.

port.title: ViP port
port.description: TCP port of the ViP protocol. Leave at 64100.

token.title: User token
token.description: 32-character token of the Comelit user Homebridge signs in as. Find it in users.cfg inside a backup downloaded from the intercom's web page (http://<intercom-ip>:8080). See the README.

enableNotifications.title: Listen for rings
enableNotifications.description: Keep a connection open to receive rings. Turn off only if you just want the door lock.

reconnectDelay.title: Reconnect delay (seconds)
reconnectDelay.description: Wait before reconnecting after the connection drops. If the intercom can't be reached, the wait doubles after each failed attempt.

maxReconnectDelay.title: Longest reconnect wait (seconds)
maxReconnectDelay.description: Upper limit for the doubling wait while the intercom can't be reached. The wait goes back to the reconnect delay once connected.

subaddress.title: User row number (sub-address)
subaddress.description: Row number (#) of that user on the intercom's Users page, e.g. 3. Give Homebridge its own user: a user shared with a phone gets each call on only one of them.

leaseRefreshMode.title: Registration refresh mode
leaseRefreshMode.description: The intercom stops sending rings to a registration after a few minutes, so it is refreshed regularly. Reconnect: drop and reopen the connection. Re-register in place: renew on the open connection, with no gap.

leaseRefreshMinutes.title: Registration refresh interval (minutes)
leaseRefreshMinutes.description: How often the registration is refreshed. 2 is proven; longer intervals may miss rings.

leaseRecycleMinutes.title: Full reconnect every (minutes, in-place mode)
leaseRecycleMinutes.description: In-place mode still reconnects fully this often, as a safety net.

ringWindowSeconds.title: Unlock allowed for (seconds after a ring)
ringWindowSeconds.description: Unlock from HomeKit is refused unless a ring happened within this many seconds. 0 allows unlocking at any time.

doorbellTriggerUrl.title: Doorbell camera trigger URL
doorbellTriggerUrl.description: Called on every ring, to make a homebridge-camera-ffmpeg doorbell send the HomeKit doorbell notification. Leave empty if you don't use one, or if you use this plugin's doorbell camera.

registerPush.title: Register as a push device (original behavior)
registerPush.description: Leave off. Registering for push diverts calls away from Homebridge.

answerMode.title: Answer the ring (experimental)
answerMode.description: Off: never take part in the call. Handshake only: reply to the call without answering it (for testing). Answer when unlocking from Home: answer the ring, open the door inside the call, then hang up. Answer when viewing the camera: opening the doorbell camera's live view answers the ring (needs the doorbell camera); unlocking then opens inside that call.

camera.title: Doorbell camera with live video (experimental)
camera.description: Adds a HomeKit doorbell camera that shows the intercom's video and audio during a ring, and rings in HomeKit itself (the camera-ffmpeg doorbell is then not needed). Video needs 'Answer when viewing the camera'. Requires ffmpeg with libfdk_aac (ffmpeg-for-homebridge).

talkBack.title: Talk back from the Home app (experimental)
talkBack.description: Sends the Home app's microphone to the intercom's speaker during a live view.

videoQuality.title: Video quality
videoQuality.description: What to ask the intercom for. A 6741W offers 320x240 and 640x240.

videoCodec.title: Video encoder
videoCodec.description: ffmpeg encoder for HomeKit. 'copy' passes the intercom's H.264 through without re-encoding (less CPU, may not play on every device).

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Leave empty to find it automatically: ffmpeg-for-homebridge (on its own or inside homebridge-camera-ffmpeg), then /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg, then ffmpeg from the system path.

snapshotImage.title: Picture when there is no call
snapshotImage.description: A JPEG shown as the camera picture when no call is in progress. Empty, or a file that doesn't exist: the picture that comes with the plugin.

mediaStartTimeoutSeconds.title: Wait for the first video or audio (seconds)
mediaStartTimeoutSeconds.description: After answering, hang up if no video or audio arrives within this time.

mediaSilenceSeconds.title: End the call after media stops for (seconds)
mediaSilenceSeconds.description: If video and audio stop arriving for this long, the call is treated as over and hung up.

videoRefreshSeconds.title: Repeat the video request every (seconds)
videoRefreshSeconds.description: The intercom stops sending video about 35 s after a request, so it is repeated.

liveViewWaitSeconds.title: Live view: wait for the intercom's video at most (seconds)
liveViewWaitSeconds.description: When the live view opens, wait this long for the intercom's video and audio, then show the picture (the Home app gives up on slow streams).

lastVisitorMinutes.title: Show the last visitor for (minutes)
lastVisitorMinutes.description: After a call, the camera picture shows the last video frame this long, then the idle picture again. 0: always the idle picture.

mediaCaptureDir.title: Save each call's video and audio to (folder)
mediaCaptureDir.description: For troubleshooting only. Saves the intercom's raw video (.h264) and audio (.alaw), and your talk-back audio, for the last 10 live views. Empty: nothing is saved.

headerDisplay: Comelit ViP intercom, fully local. Give Homebridge its own Comelit user and use its token and row number (sub-address). See the [README](https://github.com/zmanuel1234/homebridge-comelit-doorbell#readme).
